The '''Bakarn family''', formerly the '''Bakvalen family''', was a noble family on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] that made its home in [[Guardian Hold Four|Bakvalen Hall]] on [[Axial Park]]. Several generations before the [[Great Galactic War]], the family's eldest daughter [[Jhaka Bakarn|Jhaka]] became a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] fighter pilot and took on the surname Bakarn when her [[Jhaka Bakarn's father|father]] disowned her. After Jhaka died leading her squadron to victory against a [[Unidentified Outer Rim warlord|warlord]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], her father changed the family name to Bakarn to honor her. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Children of the Emperor|Child]] of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] [[Syo Bakarn]] was a descendant of the house.
